verdict.rationale: BILL's first-party docs describe registrable webhook subscriptions that deliver real-time event notifications to a `notificationUrl`. Deliveries are HMAC-SHA256 signed with an `x-bill-sha-signature` header, a 10-subscription-per-organization limit is documented, and S&E events are explicitly covered. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, S&E-specific event payload examples (documented payloads shown are AP/payment/risk), and delivery retry semantics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Subscribe to & receive real-time notifications for AP & AR events and S&E events.
When you set up a subscription for your choice of BILL events, you receive real time event notifications when those events are triggered.
BILL uses the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm to sign all event notifications sent to your `notificationUrl` with the `securityKey`.
You can create up to 10 webhook subscriptions per organization.
